layer_3_action.subject: Ornithomimus
features: small compact toothless skull with a cleanly sculpted beak profile
large prominent round eyes with an alert, high-strung gaze
cleanly closed mouth with an innocent neutral expression
crimson-red crest line running down the crown and upper neck nape
slender S-curved bird-like neck extending smoothly from its torso
aerodynamic lightweight ornithomimid body frame with a straight rigid tail held horizontally
very long thin running hind legs built for high-speed sprinting steps
slender forelimbs held naturally in a tight tuck near its chest
smooth seamless matte amber-orange clay skin with three horizontal white speed lines down its side
layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Ornithomimus with clean high-poly clay geometry is captured mid-stride in a balanced, graceful sprint across a dark mud bank. The camera frames a clean side profile at a neutral eye-level view, highlighting its exceptionally long sprinting leg lines and aerodynamic silhouette without any cartoonish over-rounding, frantic territorial cues, or terrifying expressions. It looks straight ahead with quiet alertness among stylized low cycad palms near a slow coastal estuary channel under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
